description: Edit a mask path or a shape layer's Path property: replace its vertices and tangents, make another vertex the first (Layer > Mask and Shape Path > Set First Vertex), reverse its direction, move, scale and rotate all its points about an anchor (as Free Transform Points does), or set variable-width feather points on a mask (Mask Feather tool: extent, tension, Hold, inner or outer). Points are in the layer's own pixels; tangents are relative to their vertex; vertex and segment numbers start at 0

allKeyframes.description: Apply firstVertex, reverse, transform or featherPoints to every keyframe of an animated path

closed.description: With vertices: closed path. Default true

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

featherPoints.description: Masks: replace the variable-width feather points ([] removes them)

hold.description: Hold: keep this radius to the next feather point

position.description: Where on the segment, 0 to 1. Default 0.5

segment.description: Path segment, 0 = from the first vertex to the second

firstVertex.description: Make this vertex (0-based) the first one of a closed path

inTangents.description: With vertices: in tangents relative to each vertex; default none

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

mask.description: The mask, by name or 1-based index

outTangents.description: With vertices: out tangents relative to each vertex; default none

property.description: Instead of mask: a shape layer Path property, a path of match names or names from the layer, e.g. ["ADBE Root Vectors Group", "Shape 1", "ADBE Vectors Group", "Path 1", "ADBE Vector Shape"]

reverse.description: Reverse the order of the vertices (the path direction)

time.description: Seconds: set a keyframe at this time. Default: the static value, or a keyframe at the current time when the path is animated

transform.description: Transform every point together about an anchor, as Free Transform Points does

anchor.description: Point to scale and rotate about; default the centre of the points

name: set_bezier_path
title: Set Bezier Path
